excerpt: Figure 2 plots the percentage of surface points that remain visible from one frame to the next for the Parthenon, Heroine, and Ninja sequences. The text reports that fractions of 90% and higher are typical for these game-like scenes, making many previously visible points available for reuse.
overview: This figure result grounds the survey's central premise: adjacent real-time frames often differ only modestly at the visible-surface level. The measurement does not prove all scenes are highly coherent, but it shows why reusing shaded data can be practical for common camera-motion and animated-scene workloads.
title: Visible Surface Persistence
